hypothesis: Verifying the two drafts only while the MTP layers' own probabilities for them multiply to 0.6 or more makes a full MiMo-Pro request faster than verifying both every step.
model: XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD, all 70 layers, native MXFP4 experts and FP8/BF16 dense, the three MTP layers
command: git checkout 16c234f5 c/build_mimo_cuda.bat mingw32-make -C c mimo CUDA_DLL=1 ARCH=native VK=0 python c/tools/benchmark_mimo_cuda.py --engine c/mimo.exe --model D:/AI/Models/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD --shards C:/AI/MiMoPro-Shards --backend cuda --release-host --cap 104 --threads 16 --read-threads 16 --context 16384 --tokens 64 --runs 3 --output --env MIMO_MTP= --env MIMO_MTP_MIN_P=

hardware.ram: 192 GiB installed (4 x 48 GiB), DDR5 configured at 5400 MT/s; 191.08 GiB OS-visible; ~65 GB/s measured read bandwidth
hardware.storage: C: one PCIe 5.0 x4 NVMe (88 shards, ~10.5 GB/s direct 19 MB reads); D: three PCIe 4.0 NVMe striped behind the chipset (42 shards plus model_mtp.safetensors, ~6.5 GB/s); ~17.7 GB/s together. Native Windows unbuffered reads.
hardware.os: Windows 11 Pro for Workstations 10.0.26300; MinGW-w64 GCC 14.2 MSVCRT, MSVC 14.44; RTX 4090 24 GiB WDDM, driver 617.42, CUDA Toolkit 13.2, sm_89

quality.method: Greedy: every measured reply byte-identical to the release engine's (SHA-256 0305abcd... for the benchmark; the eight varied prompts' replies unchanged); the 70-layer CPU logits unchanged (correctness/). Sampling: each kept draft at the sampler's probability (c/tests/test_mimo_sample_draft.py).
